From 608d90117ff950cce0e21c710fedeeb55a3d4963 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Szymczak <thomasthekitty@hotmail.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2014 13:43:27 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] Fix typo in pvq.c

This fixes an issue that was introduced in commit
f1a9307c8752883e8692476de72a0e1f9665ba30, "Add a 32x32 transform (and
inverse)."

Because of this bug, changing OD_DISABLE_QM to 1 in internal.h doesn't work.

Signed-off-by: Jean-Marc Valin <jmvalin@jmvalin.ca>

diff --git a/src/pvq.c b/src/pvq.c
index 023500f..2642c4b 100644
--- a/src/pvq.c
+++ b/src/pvq.c
@@ -87,7 +87,7 @@ static const double OD_PVQ_BETA32_LUMA[10] = {1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5,
 static const int OD_PVQ_QM4_CB_Q4[2] = {8, 16};
 static const int OD_PVQ_QM8_CB_Q4[5] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16};
 static const int OD_PVQ_QM16_CB_Q4[8] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16};
-static const int OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_q4[11] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16,
+static const int OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_Q4[11] = {8, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16,
  16, 16, 16};
 
 #define OD_PVQ_QM4_CR_Q4 OD_PVQ_QM4_CB_Q4
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `src/pvq.c`**
- A typo was fixed in the declaration of a constant array. The variable name `OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_q4` was changed to `OD_PVQ_QM32_CB_Q4`. This change corrects the casing of the variable name to maintain consistency with the naming convention used for other similar constants.

### Relationships
- The modification in `src/pvq.c` addresses a bug that was introduced in a previous commit (f1a9307c8752883e8692476de72a0e1f9665ba30). The bug affected the functionality related to the `OD_DISABLE_QM` setting in `internal.h`, indicating that the typo was likely causing issues with the expected behavior of the code when this setting was modified. The fix ensures that the constant is correctly referenced, which is essential for the intended functionality to work properly.
